title: Quaint Fluffy Polish Chinese Leaf Dumplings
description: A peppery and fluffy Polish dish featuring Chinese leaf, perfect for midnight cravings, and FODMAP-friendly. This recipe is a unique blend of Polish and Chinese flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, black pepper, salt, and garlic free seasoning, and mix well.
Add the chopped Chinese leaf to the bowl and mix until the leaf is evenly distributed.
In a small bowl, mix the potato starch and egg, then add the water and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the batter to the pork mixture and mix until just combined.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dumpling mixture into the simmering water.
Poach the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
